summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry (\x1b]0;{title}\x07) and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds set_window_title (terminal check only, returns bool); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title). Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Nothing was run or committed, so tests, black, and mypy are unverified.
